title: A long walk

data.source: Unconstrained and Metronomic Walking Database (Hausdorff et al. 1996), PhysioNet, doi:10.13026/C2QG66: ten adults, hour-long walks
data.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0

prediction: With everything learned on the first half of each walk, the seed rule predicts the next stride time no worse than a power-law-memory forecaster in at least 20 of 30 free walks, and no worse than AR(8) in at least 20 of 30.
baseline: A power-law (fractional) memory forecaster, which is the field's model of gait; AR(8); persistence; the mean of the last 300 strides.
why: The seed did not win in 20 of 30 walks on both counts, but on average it was within one part in a hundred of the better standard forecaster. One fading time is nearly enough; it is not better.
